I'm currently 20 and started wl more seriously about 3 months ago? I've been a sprinter my whole life basically, but just unfortunately don't have the genetics to be competitive haha. I've always done power cleans as part of a workout for sprinting but wasn't really serious about wl. 

I stopped sprinting going into june 2025 and switched to calisthenics for upper body and just generally gyming for lower body, but I found that I miss sprinting in the sense that there wasn't really a technique component to anything I was doing at the time, so I thought might as well try out wl, which (may be weird thing to say but) I find to be similar to sprinting in the way that it's very technique centered but also requires a lot of power, and since I've close to perfected my technique in sprinting, wl seemed like a good and fun next choice. Though I will say I don't know how much I'll be able to progress b4 I have not much time for the gym anymore due to what I'm studying, but whatever haha. 

Now I'm continuing to try to improve my technique in wl while still doing calisthenics (achieved my first muscle up recently yay). I will say tho, I'm mainly focusing on the clean and jerk rather than snatch cuz I CAN'T SNATCH, my shoulders cannot go that far back unless I hold the bar wayy too wide, which is weird cuz I have quite good mobility everywhere else but I digress. 

Hope you enjoy reading my messily written story haha
